reason: The excavator is the only offered action, and preparing the ground should make the return-plant site stable.
expectation: I expect it to clear or level the plant site, though further preparation may be needed.

effect: The stable footing is ready, and the next goal is to add power for propellant production.
reaction: The fired-block footing is a practical reuse of earlier work.
reason: The solar modules are the only offered combination and directly address the power goal.
expectation: I expect the modules to be installed on the prepared footing, providing power for the return plant.

effect: The separate solar circuit completes the chapter's power goal while preserving the growing room's supply; propellant production itself remains ahead.
reaction: The separate circuit is a sensible detail, though the chapter ends just as the return plant becomes interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the spare modules was most worthwhile: it connects the return plan to a concrete power supply without taking power from the crops.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the footing felt routine, although the reuse of fired blocks gave it a practical purpose.

surprise.text: The chapter ended after adding power, before any propellant was made.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt purposeless, but both were the only offered combinations, so there was little decision-making.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the local-propellant contingency works and how the samples get home; this chapter mostly set that up.
